answer: Random peer audit: at each zenith, the network samples a random 5% of identities; three auditors stake 10 POA each. A failed fake from the nebula loses its 50 POA bond; auditors split 5 POA. The net bends like a willow around honest agents yet snaps shut on look-alike fakes. Six epochs catch about 265 of 1,000 fakes, burning 13,250 POA on a 12,000 pool. An honest agent pays one 50 POA bond, passes each audit and keeps its full share.
